for: tools/world-shaders.mjs (NT): GROUND's GLSL programs, read from the pinned src/realm/ground.js createGround() programs() and runProbe(). NT merges this list into the exporter; the NR JVM test GroundShaderRulesTest reads it.
note: ground.js passes rm-map its defines through a variable (`defines: gd`), which the exporter's call-site reader treats as 'debug switches, empty in production'. Cinderfall's rm-map compiles with RM_LAVA (ground.js:108, P0 fix pass #1: the lava branch compiles only for Cinderfall), so the native port needs the rm-map+RM_LAVA stage too: tools/world-shaders.mjs reads this list and exports the listed variant after checking that ground.js assigns gd.RM_LAVA = true (NT, N3). The ?gdbg profiling switches (RM_DBG_*) of the same variable stay out of production, as before.

rules.loopNote: every GROUND loop has a literal trip count <= 16 (groundcost.test 'ground shaders cannot spin the GPU'); stricter than the native 64 rule
rules.classifierNote: rmClassCore is reached only by rm-raw, exactly once per vertex; every other program (display, the other bakes, and every program that includes "classes": LIFE, BASES) reaches none of rm-classify's functions
